plugin_audit.title: Data change audit
plugin_audit.description: Records inserts, updates and deletes on audited tables with field-level before/after comparison; sensitive fields are masked

scope.title: Audited tables
scope.description: Only the tables selected here are audited; nothing is audited by default. This plugin's own tables and log-style tables are excluded.
scope.noneSelected: No table is audited right now, so no change records will be produced.
scope.note: Takes effect immediately on this instance; other instances sync within 30 seconds. Values of password / secret / token fields are always recorded as ***.

clean.title: Clean change records
clean.description: Deletes records older than the retention period. This cannot be undone.
